The sports sedan built by sports-car fanatics.
If it’s not worth driving, it’s not worth building. That’s why the Mazda6
was built by car-crazy engineers to perform like a sports car and
achieve class-leading aerodynamics. It delivers more V6 torque than
Camry or Accord, and it can achieve up to 30 MPG hwy.* It seats five
and offers more rear legroom than Accord. Creating a stylish, roomy
sedan that’s also exciting to drive may not be the easiest thing in the
world to pull off, but for Mazda, it’s the only kind of sedan we’d build.
And what’s not to love about that?

enjoy roomy comfort with thoughtful accommodation. For example, a center
console with dual storage compartments and a sliding armrest, plus two 12V
outlets for powering your phone, laptop or MP3 player.* All in an environment
of uncompromising craftsmanship and refinement.
